solutions.title: Quadratic DP by ending index
solutions.strategy: Let dp[i] be the best increasing subsequence length ending at i and compare against every earlier index.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each pair of indices may be compared once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: One DP value is stored per input index.

solutions.title: Patience tails with binary search
solutions.strategy: Maintain the smallest possible tail value for every increasing subsequence length.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each value performs one binary search over the tails array.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The tails array can grow to length n for a fully increasing input.
